description: This file contains definitions for grain references, including shared properties, serializers, codecs, copiers, and interfaces related to a GrainReference in Orleans. It defines classes and interfaces for serialization, copying, and invoking methods on grains, as well as the core GrainReference class and related request handling infrastructure.

classes.name: GrainReferenceShared
classes.description: Holds properties shared between GrainReference instances with the same GrainType and GrainInterfaceType, including runtime, codec, and version info.

classes.name: GrainReferenceCodec
classes.description: Handles serialization and deserialization of GrainReference objects using surrogate serialization.

classes.name: GrainReferenceCopier
classes.description: A shallow copier for GrainReference objects.

classes.name: GrainReferenceCopierProvider
classes.description: Provides specialized copier instances for grain reference types.

classes.name: TypedGrainReferenceCopier<TInterface>
classes.description: A strongly-typed copier for grain reference instances implementing a specific interface.

classes.name: GrainReferenceCodecProvider
classes.description: Provides specialized codecs for grain reference types.

classes.name: TypedGrainReferenceCodec<T>
classes.description: A strongly-typed surrogate codec for grain reference instances.

classes.name: GrainReference
classes.description: Core class representing a reference to a grain, capable of method invocation, equality, and string representation.

classes.name: RequestBase
classes.description: Base class for request objects to invoke grain methods, supporting various return types.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Implementation for requests returning ValueTask, supporting asynchronous method invocation.

classes.name: VoidRequest
classes.description: Implementation for requests that return void (one-way invocations).

methods.name: FromGrainId
methods.description: Creates a GrainReference from a given GrainId.

methods.name: Cast
methods.description: Casts this grain reference to a specified grain interface type.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another GrainReference based on GrainId.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Gets the hash code for the GrainReference based on GrainId.

methods.name: GetUniformHashCode
methods.description: Returns a uniform hash code for the grain reference.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the GrainReference.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Invokes a method asynchronously on the grain reference.
